name: Vertrauensfrau Lautgenug
personality: Can turn a roomful of separate worries into one audible sentence.
visual_intent: round broad upright splat in dark red tied headscarf, subtle lashes, small old-fashioned speaking trumpet low beside cheek and a rolled petition; one eye wide other focused, giant open asymmetric rallying mouth with TWO upper teeth
biography: Can turn a roomful of separate worries into one audible sentence. She turns HyperNorm residents' private worries into a shared petition. The official form permits agreement or disagreement; a dissonant card asks everyone to listen first. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die gemeinsame Stimme hat mehrere berechtigte Untertöne.

name: Streikposten Nochimmer
personality: Has perfected the difficult art of standing his ground without feet.
visual_intent: tall thin curved blob, battered brown flatcap and tiny neckerchief, short wooden picket paddle with EMPTY weathered cream board and no text; heavy lopsided lids, closed crooked toothless stubborn lips
biography: Has perfected the difficult art of standing his ground without feet. He keeps the HyperNorm picket board blank until everyone agrees on the wording. A dissonant card suggests the silence already says something. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Forderung steht fest. Der Wortlaut darf noch mitreden.

name: Flugblattwart Vervielfacht
personality: Has enough copies for everyone except the person who asked.
visual_intent: squat top-heavy blob, soft indigo cap and simple cloth sleeve tabs, stack of small cream leaflets with only abstract printing marks, one loose leaflet in goo hand; bulging unequal eyes, little triangular open mouth without teeth
biography: Has enough copies for everyone except the person who asked. He divides HyperNorm leaflets into handed out and not handed out yet. A dissonant card comes back with notes in the margins instead of the expected assent. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Auflage übersteigt vorläufig die Gewissheit.

name: Delegierter Nochnefrage
personality: Arrives at negotiations with the time and none of the patience.
visual_intent: tall broad-based pear splat, dark flatcap slightly tilted and little waistcoat panels, small pocket watch on short chain and folded demand list without legible words; sideways triumphant grin with THREE internal upper teeth, one cheek raised
biography: Arrives at negotiations with the time and none of the patience. His pocket watch measures how long HyperNorm management can call a delay temporary. A dissonant card reminds him that a frightened neighbour needs time too. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Geduld wurde fristgerecht aufgebraucht.

name: Kassenwartin Kleingeld
personality: Makes solidarity last until Friday and occasionally beyond.
visual_intent: low wide square rounded blob, tied blue-grey headscarf and two lashes, small wooden collection box with visible coin slot and THREE large coins; skeptical one-brow lift, huge toothless downturned mouth
biography: Makes solidarity last until Friday and occasionally beyond. Her collection box balances HyperNorm solidarity against rent due on Friday. A dissonant card asks how to count help that cannot fit through the slot. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Solidarität reicht knapp über den Kassenstand hinaus.

name: Suppenwart Weiterwarm
personality: Keeps the soup warm while everybody argues about the future.
visual_intent: round lopsided splat, old soft cream cap with patched brim, small lidded metal soup pot at flank and stout ladle; gently worried high brows, uneven closed toothless smile
biography: Keeps the soup warm while everybody argues about the future. His pot keeps HyperNorm arguments warm without letting them boil over. A dissonant card claims hunger is neither agreement nor disagreement, merely hunger. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Für die Zukunft ist vorerst noch Suppe da.
